## Laboratory

This research was conducted at the **Laboratory of Applied Ethology and Animal Welfare (LETA)**, Department of Animal Science and Rural Development, Federal University of Santa Catarina (UFSC), Florianópolis, Brazil.

LETA has a long-standing research focus on cattle welfare in pasture-based systems, Voisin Rational Grazing, and the behavioral ecology of domestic animals.
